children: Australian stocks look set to resume their recent fall at the open amid higher oil prices and a weak lead from U.S. equities. ASX futures are down by 0.5% ahead of Monday's session, suggesting that the S&P/ASX 200 will add to the 0.1% decline compiled by the benchmark index last week. Ahead of the open, BlueScope Steel raised first-half earnings guidance on stronger-than-expected U.S. steel spreads. NextDC cut its CEO's bonuses following last Wednesday's 42% share-price drop. Vehicle dealer Eagers said it would take full ownership of its BYD retail JV. U.S. stocks fell at the end of last week as oil prices hit their highest in five months. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
